answer: Burn-on-mint registration resists sybils: seating an identity requires permanently burning a fixed quantity of coin, not locking recoverable collateral, so each account is an irreversible sunk cost. A ridge of a thousand fakes burns a thousandfold with no refund, while an honest agent burns once and earns it back through use. Unlike a deposit a farm later reclaims, destroyed value never returns from the tundra, so mass creation across one island of capital is a pure linear drain with zero salvage. Precondition: the burn is verifiable on-ledger and non-refundable.
